title: Iterators, Symbol.iterator, and for-of
hook: The iterator protocol — next() returning { value, done } — powers for-of, spread, and destructuring. Symbol.iterator is the well-known key collections implement to become iterable.

blocks.text: An **iterator** is an object with **next()** returning `{ value, done }`. An **iterable** has `Symbol.iterator` method returning a fresh iterator. **for...of** calls Symbol.iterator internally. **Spread** and **Array.from** consume iterables. Strings, Arrays, Map, Set are iterable; plain objects are not unless you add Symbol.iterator.

entries.plainDefinition: Object with next() producing value/done pairs.
Key for default iterator — not enumerable in for...in.
Loops values from iterable; works with break/continue.

blocks.text: Custom iterables integrate with language syntax — CSV parser, paginated API, tree walk. for...of vs for...in: of gets values, in gets enumerable keys. C# IEnumerable/GetEnumerator is the parallel; JS uses duck-typed protocol.

blocks.title: for...in vs for...of
blocks.body: for...in on arrays iterates indices as strings plus enumerable props — prefer for...of for array values.

diagram.title: Iterator protocol
diagram.source:
sequenceDiagram
  participant F as for...of
  participant I as Iterator
  F->>I: Symbol.iterator()
  loop until done
    F->>I: next()
    I-->>F: value done

snippet.label: Manual iterator
snippet.explanation: Iterable returns itself as iterator. Spread and for...of consume same protocol.

snippet.label: Map iteration order
snippet.explanation: Map iterates insertion order. Destructuring in for...of uses entries by default.

snippet.label: Make object iterable
snippet.explanation: Plain objects need explicit Symbol.iterator to work with for...of.

snippet.label: Failure mode — for...in on array
snippet.explanation: for...in enumerates all enumerable keys including custom props — not array values alone.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: for...in on arrays. Assuming plain object works in for...of. Reusing exhausted iterator without fresh Symbol.iterator call. Not implementing return() on iterators holding resources.

blocks.text: **Iterator helpers** (ES2024) add map/filter/take on iterators lazily. **Generators** are easiest way to implement iterables. Know difference **iterable vs iterator** — for...of always gets fresh iterator from Symbol.iterator. **Async iteration** uses Symbol.asyncIterator — module 13 async. Manual **next()** throw propagates to consumer.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Cannot define iterator protocol. Uses for...in on arrays in production code. Confuses iterable with iterator object.

interviewTakeaways: Iterator: next() -> {value, done}. Iterable: Symbol.iterator method.
for...of consumes iterables; for...in enumerates keys.
Map/Set/Array/String are iterable; plain object is not.
60s: Protocol steps. for...in vs for...of array trap. Symbol.iterator. C# foreach parallel.
commonPitfalls: Weak: "for...in loops array values." Strong: "for...in gives keys; for...of gives values via iterator."
Weak: "Objects work in for...of." Strong: "Need Symbol.iterator unless Object.keys manual loop."
Strong: "Show arr.foo breaking for...in but not for...of."
